title: Return demonstration in Baghdad Tahrir Square after tent removal

occurrence.summary: Shafaq reports demonstrators actually gathered in Tahrir Square on Sunday evening.

location.summary: Exact site identified as Baghdad Tahrir Square.

onset.summary: Article posted Nov1 and describes Sunday evening return the day after tent removal; exact day assessed as Nov1, subject to review.

domestic_state_demand.summary: Gathering follows security-force removal of tents; source provides movement context but does not specify the returning crowd’s demand. Pending target eligibility.

episode_ownership.summary: Direct continuation of Tahrir movement/tent removal at prior month boundary; specific action may be separate from encampment.

title: Basra protests over jobs, services and security-force camp removal
location: Basra near local administration building/Bahriya Square area; exact site not resolved

occurrence.summary: Article documents active protests in Basra on Nov6 and says demonstrations had been held in the city for the prior three days.

location.summary: Near local administration building; article also refers to re-erecting tents at Bahriya Square, exact site of counted gathering unresolved.

onset.summary: Three days of protests as of Fri Nov6 imply series began about Nov4; first day with attendance evidence not resolved.

attendance_threshold.summary: Within the same report, it says hundreds clashed but also several dozen took streets. Conflicting qualitative sizes leave >=50 threshold pending.

domestic_state_demand.summary: Demand jobs/basic services and resignation of Basra governor/investigation of previous killings; directed at domestic government.

episode_ownership.summary: Article frames protest as renewed after camp removal and ongoing for three days. November/October tent-clearing relation needs follow-up.

state_response.summary: Article links police clash, a protester death and 40 wounded to the Basra protest; keep any day-specific attribution under review.

title: Daily-wage employees protest at Baghdad Electricity Ministry
location: In front of Ministry of Electricity, Baghdad

occurrence.summary: Shafaq reports an actual demonstration in front of the Ministry.

location.summary: Exact named government ministry in Baghdad.

onset.summary: Contemporaneous timestamp dates report Nov22; event is reported as taking place “today.”

attendance_threshold.summary: Shafaq reports hundreds of daily-wage employees.

domestic_state_demand.summary: Protest opposes the Electricity Minister’s transfer decision affecting up to 37,000 contracts.

episode_ownership.summary: No continuation or neighboring-month linked action found in the limited captures; further follow-up remains feasible.
